ways.label: Kaitoke Road End to Smith Creek Shelter via Puffer Saddle

via.name: Kiwi Ranch Road
via.quote: The track begins on Kiwi Ranch Road

evidence: Kaitoke Road End to Smith Creek Shelter via Puffer Saddle – returning back on the same track (13 km, 4 - 5.5 hours; walking track)
Return back to the road end the way you came, following the track up Smith Creek and over Puffer Saddle.

ways.label: Dobson Loop Track – full loop tramp

via.name: Southern Crossing turnoff
via.quote: turnoff with the Southern Crossing track

evidence: Dobson Loop Track – full loop tramp (11.5 km; tramping track)
For a clockwise loop (described here), take this track.
It meets the turnoff with the Southern Crossing, then the track continues down to Kiwi Ranch Road.

doubts: Page presents two ways under one name; DOC's time (5.5 hr return to Smith Creek Shelter) matches the first, so it is main, though the walk is named Dobson Loop Track, hence kind unclear. Carpark is about 500 m along Kiwi Ranch Road; F2 (track meets Kiwi Ranch Road) taken as the start. Smith Creek Shelter is a shelter, not listed as hut (no bunks stated). Unbridged stream crossings along Smith Creek are not named so not recorded as fords.
